verdict.rationale: Throttling or queueing workflow executions is a fair question for a workflow orchestration engine, so the axis applies. The pack documents retries, durable execution, scheduling and a Cloud namespace capacity mode of 500 APS, but nothing on user-configurable rate limiting, task-queue throttling, or concurrency caps for downstream calls. The APS figure is a platform billing and capacity setting, not a developer throttling control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
